opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead email draft
opportunities.description: For a given GitHub username, look up the user profile and top repo, then compose an email to hiring@example.com with a lead summary for a given role.
steps: Open GitHub search and type the username
Press Enter and open the Users results
Note followers count and latest post
Open the top repository and note stars and language
Enter Body with followers, top repo, stars, language and latest post

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person lookup plus Wayback snapshot note
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia, view an Internet Archive snapshot of a related site for a given year, and save a summary note.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia
Read the key facts (birth date, role)
Open archive.org Wayback and enter the company domain
Select the year and a snapshot
Add a note combining the facts and snapshot text
